extension.summary: Automatically adjusts zoom for anamorphic setups.
extension.description: For users with a 16:9 projector, anamorphic lens, and widescreen display. When suitable 16:9 video is played, this service uses validated Dolby Vision L5 metadata when available, otherwise looks up the content aspect ratio online, calculates a safe zoom, and sets the required pixel ratio. If metadata or the online lookup is unavailable, playback is left unchanged.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - Added asynchronous lookup, caching, safer metadata/scraping, and reversible view-mode handling.
